Cache only dependency download state, use exact keys without broad restore fallbacks, and always run every original install and test command on cache hits. Do not skip work based on cache-hit outputs. For timeout patterns change only job timeout-minutes, using baseline evidence with headroom. Do not add networking/deploy/publish/secret usage or replace action versions. The baseline already passed the required checks. Keep the change narrow so those same commands still run and can pass; the measured CI runs determine whether the candidate succeeds and whether it helps. If the method has a limitation, record it in rationale but still implement the closest valid version of the selected method. Return ONLY JSON: {pattern_id, decision: APPLY, rationale, workflow_yaml}. workflow_yaml must contain the complete changed file.

cover: ## Run unit tests with coverage report
	go test -coverprofile=coverage.txt ./...
	go tool cover -func=coverage.txt

.PHONY: all-tests
all-tests: test cover ## run all tests

.PHONY: all-checks
all-checks: lint ## run all formatters
